title: Alarm Optimization Senior Design Project
points: Led a team of 4 to make a Python webapp for refinery engineers to analyze alarm floods and improve alarm operational performance

Designed and implemented alarm webpage system architecture using Python (High-Level KPI summaries, alarm frequency rankings, flood event tables, severity categorizations) to analyze and detect critical alarm patterns
Implemented threshold flood detection logic and generated event tables with severity distributions to identify alarm flood density
Partnered directly with BP engineers to gather requirements and translate real-world alarm operational challenges into system features
Validated outputs using 10+ real refinery datasets and aligned system functionality with industry standards (EEMUA 191, ISA-18.2)
Presented the solution to 30+ BP engineers, securing positive feedback and deployment of the app onto BP’s Azure webserver
Tech Stack: Python, Streamlit.io, Plotly, Debugging, Code Review, Control Systems Theory
